flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4345/#HelloThere then Wait until the page has fully loaded and the tiddler titled HelloThere is visible.
In the row of buttons at the top right of the HelloThere tiddler, click the edit button (a pencil icon).
Wait 2 seconds until the tiddler changes into an editor with a title box at the top and a large text box.
In that editor, find the small input below the title box that shows the grey placeholder text 'tag name', and click once inside it so the cursor is there.
Do not type anything.
If a list of tags drops down below the input, @v16:"leave it open and do not click anything else."
Verify that this is true: The HelloThere tiddler is open in an editor, with a title box, a tag input with the placeholder text 'tag name', and a large text box.
